_meta.purpose: Deterministic proper-noun / non-word post-pass for correct_text_v2. Raises recall on obvious ASR errors the conservative windowed model holds (because the wrong token is a real word) or fixes inconsistently. Runs AFTER windowed_correct, before writing .correct.v2.srt. NO LLM, NO model spend, NO bulk pipeline change.
_meta.principle: A token is SAFE to correct by plain token-replace only when the ASR form is a NON-WORD (cannot appear in correct Persian), so replacing it can never corrupt a correct sentence. A wrong token that is itself a REAL word (عصرا, قوم, عرق, قزه) is CONTEXT-DEPENDENT and is either handled by a file-level guard, or left for the LLM context layer (not built). Protected terms are program/show names that a corrector must NEVER 'fix'.
sources: docs/prompts/v2-tuned-edits.txt (376 changed blocks, temp-0.0 tuned run)

context_rules.note: عرق (sweat) is a real word → only swap when the block co-occurs with Tikrit, unambiguously Iraq.
علمی/حوزه + scientific-hub sense → Qom the city, not people.

_deferred_context_layer.reason: عصرا (afternoon) is a real word; the right call (prisoners) needs sentence meaning. Left for the LLM context layer, not the deterministic post-pass.
